decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis and consent app builds directly on the firm's deep knowledge of dental practice management software and workflows, and it was launched as a new product line, so the firm can readily read early results and improve it.

The education institute uses the firm's long-standing knowledge of dental practices and its existing customer training, though it lies further from core software development and so has somewhat higher risk.
The remote screen-sharing tool supports the firm's established customer service and uses its existing IT support competence, so it fits the firm's knowledge base and is cheap to maintain.
